name: Alex Lieberman
bio: Serial entrepreneur best known as co-founder of Morning Brew, the business media company he started as a college newsletter and grew to 2M+ daily readers before its ~$75M sale to Business Insider in 2020. He is now co-founder and Managing Partner of Tenex, an AI engineering and transformation firm (co-founded with Arman Hezarkhani) that helps companies go from AI-absent to AI-native. He also founded Storyarb and Distro, hosts the Founder's Journal podcast, and co-hosts The Crazy Ones. Recognized on Forbes 30 Under 30 and AdAge 40 Under 40; based in New York City. At AI Engineer NYC 2026 he served as MC, delivering the welcome, keynote intros, and closing remarks.
